title: EEO Archive, release 2026-11-19: public tables of the Repetition and Discernibility Audit
description:
Per-attempt records of public robot evaluations, re-published as flat tables, with the intra-cluster correlation estimates, design effects and effective sample sizes that follow from them.

The observatory does not evaluate robots. It checks the numbers evaluations publish: whether the spread between runs is real, and how many attempts a claim needs before its interval means anything. Every estimate quoted here can be recomputed from the published table alone, using tools/verify_public.py.

Licence, three blocks. (1) The compilation, the de-identification and all computed statistics are CC-BY-4.0; attribute as EEO Archive, release 2026-11-19. (2) The per-attempt result fields originate in the public source archive named in the dataset card; their rights remain with the source, and this deposit cites them as facts without relicensing them. (3) From release 2026-11-17 the snapshot is redistributed so the export can be re-run; those copies are hashed and published, so anyone holding one can verify it. The deposit as a whole is therefore offered as other-open, not as CC-BY-4.0 over third-party content.

Scope: this deposit contains records and reliability measurements, not evaluation conclusions about any robot or model.
